localValidation.restartCoverage: A local Chromium renderer was crashed with CDP Page.crash after records committed. The persistent browser context was fully closed and relaunched from the same disk profile, without reinjecting authentication or conversation state. Collapsed state was also checked after immediate reload and another full relaunch.
localValidation.backgroundCoverage: The page closed with A generating while B was selected. On reopening, A resumed by its original generation ID, B stayed unchanged, and returning to A displayed its updated tasks. One task_update and one final model answer were observed; no replayed generation.
localValidation.keyboardCoverage: Chromium viewport resizing and simulated VisualViewport height / offsetTop; no physical iOS or Android device test

limits: Full history remains in the same browser IndexedDB; it is not automatically synchronized between devices.
Crash recovery assertions cover committed records, not data that was never saved.
